consulting.title: Logistics consulting
consulting.description: Beyond freight forwarding, we help design your supply chain structure and overseas expansion strategy. Shippers and forwarders face different challenges, so we tailor our approach to each.
consulting.clientDescription: We diagnose your supply chain and redesign cost and lead time.
consulting.forwarderDescription: We accompany you through each stage of overseas expansion, down to local execution.

diagnosis.title: Supply chain diagnosis
diagnosis.subtitle: Supply Chain Diagnosis
diagnosis.description: We analyse cost and lead-time bottlenecks in your current logistics structure.
diagnosis.detail: We review your current logistics flow leg by leg and map out where cost and lead time are generated. We then propose the points that need improvement, together with priorities.

routing.title: Multi-mode routing design
routing.subtitle: Multi-mode Routing
routing.description: We combine air, ocean, road and rail to design routes that meet your lead time and cost conditions.
routing.detail: We combine air, ocean, road, rail and express to design routes that meet your lead time and cost conditions. We also review switching legs currently handled by a single mode to multimodal transport.

vendor.title: Logistics partner optimisation
vendor.subtitle: Vendor Consolidation
vendor.description: We consolidate scattered vendors to simplify management and restructure rates.
vendor.detail: We consolidate logistics partners spread across multiple vendors, reducing points of contact and restructuring your rate base. We decide together which partners to keep and which to merge, leg by leg.

ecommerce.title: E-commerce / FBA logistics advisory
ecommerce.subtitle: E-commerce & FBA
ecommerce.description: We advise on logistics operations tailored to e-commerce flows and FBA inbound requirements.
ecommerce.detail: We advise on operating models suited to e-commerce cargo, which comes in small and highly variable order units, and to FBA inbound requirements. We build a transport plan that accounts for inbound specifications and lead times.

marketEntry.title: Overseas expansion strategy
marketEntry.subtitle: Market Entry Strategy
marketEntry.description: We help design your target markets, entry model and initial operating structure.
marketEntry.detail: We review together which countries to enter, in what form, and how to structure your initial operating team. Our advice is based on operating experience gained on the ground.

entitySetup.title: Local entity setup support
entitySetup.subtitle: Local Entity Setup
entitySetup.description: We support the full setup process based on our experience operating entities in Korea, China and Vietnam.
entitySetup.detail: Drawing on our experience directly operating entities in Shanghai, Weihai, Guangzhou and Hanoi, we work through the setup process with you. We guide you on required documents and sequencing, and accompany you through local execution.

matching.title: Partner matching
matching.subtitle: Partner Matching
matching.description: We connect you with a vetted network of local partners to establish an initial commercial base.
matching.detail: We introduce local partners we have verified through direct business. To help you build a commercial base quickly, we start with partners for the legs you need most.

funding.title: Government funding support
funding.subtitle: Government Funding
funding.description: We help identify government support programmes for overseas expansion and prepare applications.
funding.detail: We identify and explain government support programmes related to overseas expansion, and prepare the application process with you. We first confirm your eligibility and the requirements involved.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Common questions about quotations, transit times and customs procedures.

items.question: How do I request a quote?
items.answer: Let us know the origin and destination, the commodity, weight and volume, and your required delivery date, and our team will come back to you with a quotation. You can use the enquiry form at the bottom of this page or our main email address.

items.question: Which transport modes are available?
items.answer: We operate all five modes: air, ocean (including SEA / SEA-AIR multimodal), road, rail and express. Tell us your lead time and budget and we will design the optimal route using a single mode or multimodal transport.

items.question: Do you handle domestic transport in China and Vietnam?
items.answer: Yes. Because we directly operate entities in Shanghai, Weihai, Guangzhou and Hanoi, we handle FTL/LTL across all 31 provinces of China and cross-border trucking to Vietnam and Thailand ourselves.

items.question: How long does transport take?
items.answer: It depends on the mode and the lane. Express runs 5–7 days door-to-door from Korea to Europe, air freight typically takes several days, and ocean freight takes several weeks depending on the lane. Customs clearance may add further time.

items.question: How can I check where my cargo is?
items.answer: API integration with our own JSL-EXPRESS system lets you check delivery status in real time. Contract clients can also look up shipments in progress directly from the dashboard.

items.question: What does logistics consulting cover?
items.answer: For shippers we provide supply chain diagnosis, multi-mode routing design, logistics partner optimisation and e-commerce/FBA advisory. For forwarders we support overseas expansion strategy, local entity setup, partner matching and government funding applications.
